saw_lines: Ayurvedic juice is a trust purchase. Buyers compare many look alike bottles and rarely order the first one without a reason.
So the first order is won or lost in the opening line, before a stranger scrolls past the offer.
Your site offers a first order discount, yet 0 of 29 ads mention it or any offer. Open three ads with that discount on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers a first order discount, yet 0 of 29 ads mention it or any offer. New buyers have no reason to order. Open three ads with that discount on the creative, and put free shipping above ₹399 in line two.

Your site explains shipping, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery. Buyers who cannot test a juice first want to know when it arrives. Answer that in line one of new ads, and name free shipping above ₹399.

3 of 29 ads use claim words like clinically, cure and guaranteed results, and that limits reach. Swap each claim for what customers noticed in their first weeks, and open the next three ads with that line.
0 of 29 ads carry a proof number, so a buyer comparing juices has nothing concrete to trust. Add one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and lead three new video ads with it.

ads_1: Juice ads led by the first order discount, with shipping answered in line two
